_meta.title: LiveWire S2 Del Mar - UDS DID catalog
_meta.description: Machine-readable attribution of the active UDS DID sweep (service 0x22 ReadDataByIdentifier) across the 9 mapped diagnostic modules. This is the UDS-layer companion to the broadcast-CAN .dbc: values here are NOT broadcast on secondary CAN and were harvested via the AtomS3 firmware Diagnostics mode + tools/uds_map.py / tools/stream_uds.py.
generated_from: docs/livewire_s2_CAN_uds_data_map.md (S1 module/DID table + S2 per-module bullets + S6/S7)
dbc/livewire_s2_delmar_secondary.dbc (UDS-DERIVED CALIBRATION / CROSS-CHECKS block + MODULE MAP - RESOLVED)
_meta.note: GENERATED FROM THE DOCS - not hand-authored ground truth. The prose docs above remain authoritative; regenerate this file when they change. Scales/offsets marked candidate are direction/structure-confirmed but not unit-locked. See dbc/README.md for the schema and the cross-layer link table.

status_values.confirmed: corroborated across >=2 sessions/intents or pinned by direct count; safe to rely on
status_values.candidate: direction/structure holds but scale, exact offset, or full semantics still open (includes 0x27 security-locked DIDs, whose contents are inferred by adjacency)
status_values.refuted: an earlier attribution that was disproven; kept so the dead hypothesis is not re-attempted

bus.transport: ISO-TP / UDS over the DLC, gatewayed by the BCM; 0x22 ReadDataByIdentifier reads, 0x19/02 ReadDTC overheard passively
bus.module_count: 9 mapped responders (a floor: resp 0x6E6/req 0x6DE and target 0x7F2 are unmapped + passive-only; the IMU has no UDS address - the VSC monitors it)
bus.security: 16 DIDs are 0x27 SecurityAccess-locked across BCM/VSC/TCU (128-bit random seeds); the rest read in default session with plain 0x22
bus.caveat: the offline uds_map.py hex-formatter truncates arrays at 46 bytes; multi-frame (ISO-TP) DIDs polled through the round-robin can cross-stitch - such DIDs stay candidate until read under flow control

BCM.role: Body Control Module (secondary-bus gateway); F191 41001171A; DTC_COUNT=3 == dash "BCM 3"

0202.name: grouped 16-bit ADC snapshot; byte8 = longitudinal accel / traction-demand
0202.encoding_or_scale: 12x BE16 but a 4/3/1/3/1 replicate pattern = 5 distinct live quantities; b8 oscillates ~78-129, rest-anchor ~106 = 0 g
0202.evidence: b8 vs long_g s28 r=0.93 (n=413), s44 r=0.931 vs acc_lon / 0.943 vs torque_del (n=256); rest-anchor 106 on charge, r~0 vs pack current. CAVEAT accel/torque collinear on a bike. The ADC groups are load-reactive housekeeping (HV-bus sag r~0.9-0.97), NOT pack telemetry.

0226.name: composite time-sync record (uptime tick ++ Unix-seconds wall-clock)
0226.evidence: 0226 tail == 0200 head exactly; A ticks within a sweep, B advances between sweeps (s26 re-confirmed). A never-network/GPS-synced RTC on a MY2024 bike - usable only as a coarse stream-uptime anchor, not a real timestamp.

0194.name: ride-mode roster / config table (mode-id <-> slot map)
0194.encoding_or_scale: full 7-mode roster (0x134 D1 hi-nibble mode id): 11 Road(user:Street), 22 Sport, 33 Rain, 44 Range(user:Eco), 55 Flat Track, 88 Custom A, 99 Custom B (also 0195-0197)
0194.evidence: CAN 0x134 broadcasts only the ACTIVE mode; this is the full roster.

0170.name: coding / immobilizer / KEY block (0170-0177 contiguous)
0170.encoding_or_scale: 0x27 security-locked; largest locked surface on the bike
0170.evidence: 12 locked DIDs on BCM incl. the 0170-0177 KEY block + 0120/0141/0145/0147; readable neighbors are single-byte option/feature flags (0123/0132/0136.../0144 = A5A5 init marker).

LHCM.role: Left Hand Control Module (switch pod); part 0819112-0010; DTC_COUNT=2 == dash "LHCM 2"; also carries VIN

F191.name: hardware part number
F191.evidence: pure switch cluster - all its states are already on CAN; no high-value data DIDs. 029B/029C analogs here are internal reference rails (drift OPPOSITE the RHCM), NOT twist-grip.

VSC.role: Vehicle Supervisory Controller (supervisory FUNCTION of the PEU/inverter); F193 41001094A2; logs powertrain P-codes, monitors ABS+IMU

020C.name: live MOTOR shaft speed (RPM) + drive-state byte
020C.encoding_or_scale: word0 (u16@0) offset-binary 0x8000 = signed MOTOR speed in native RPM (1 rpm/count); byte2 = drive-state (0x01 stop / 0x02 move)
020C.evidence: REFINED 2026-07-30 (ultracode round, s61 hot ride): word0-0x8000 ranged 0..4736 over the ride - FAR beyond any km/h scale, so the native unit is MOTOR RPM, not road speed km/h. Tracks the MOTOR more tightly than the wheel (model-fit residual 5-7 rpm to motor/resolver vs 31-40 rpm to the front wheel across s57/s55/s61; slope 0.9997-0.9998, intercept ~-32768; never wraps -> a speed not a raw angle). Correlates r=1.0 with broadcast road speed only because motor rpm is proportional to it via the ~3.85:1 reduction. SUPERSEDES the earlier 'live road speed (km/h)' scale label (the r=1.0-vs-speed evidence was real but the unit was misread). byte2 = 0x02 throughout every driving capture, 0x01 stationary (s59). REVERSE 2026-07-30 (ultracode): word0 is genuinely SIGNED - drops below 0x8000 in reverse (floor ~-90 rpm streamed s8/s22/s23/s28/s31/s44, ~-215 rpm legacy hand-spins), matching broadcast 0x160 rpm sign+magnitude to +/-1 ct. byte2 stays 0x02 (DRIVE) in reverse IDENTICAL to forward - no 0x03 or reverse code exists in the 66-file corpus - so direction is carried ONLY by the word0 sign, never by the drive-state byte.

0207.name: live torque record (offset-5000): speed-derating drive ceiling + static regen limit + requested/applied/delivered
0207.encoding_or_scale: BE16 offset-5000 (0x1388 = zero, same as bus 0x161). word0 (@0) = live drive-torque CEILING that DERATES with speed (NOT a static clamp); word1 (@2) = static regen limit 3750=-1250; @4=requested / @6=applied (candidate) / @8=delivered; bytes10-13 dead 0x00
0207.evidence: REFINED 2026-07-30 (s61, 1245 samples): word0 is NOT the static +1875 clamp - it ranges raw 5025..6875 (=+25..+1875, 9 discrete levels), highest at low speed and derating toward ~0 with speed = a constant-power ceiling. @8 (delivered) has the widest live range (-276..+1006, r=0.982-0.989 vs bus 0x161 torque_delivered s61/s57/s55) => CONFIRMED delivered. @4/@6 track delivered closely (requested/applied roles are s61-specific: @4 collapses to r=0.80 in s57) => CANDIDATE. word1=3750=-1250 constant all rides. Offset-5000 = 2nd independent witness for the 0x161 zero. CAVEAT the +1875 drive / -1250 regen clamp MAGNITUDES are still untested - peak live torque reached only ~53% of the drive clamp; never clamped. REVERSE 2026-07-30 (ultracode, s8): @0 drive-ceiling and @2 regen-limit -1250 held flat across all 13 reverse samples (static low-speed limits); @8 delivered tracked broadcast 0x161 including the sign at the exact reverse point (-26/-26); @4/@6 pinned near zero in reverse so the requested-vs-applied ordering stays candidate. FIELD-WEAKENING measured 2026-07-30 (s54/s55/s61, near-full-throttle torque_request vs motor rpm): the @0 ceiling derate IS the constant-power / flux-weakening region above a base speed of ~2200 motor rpm (~48 mph) - REFINED from the full torque-vs-speed envelope: peak torque_request holds ~1120 counts to ~46 mph then rolls off monotonically to 634 @ 99 mph / 455 @ 105 mph (torque x rpm ~constant), while pack power (RESS 0209 x pack V) plateaus at ~60-69 kW (peak 69 kW @ 4411 rpm / ~94 mph, -239 A) from ~48 mph to the ~5000 rpm redline. The base-speed KNEE is ~mode-INVARIANT (Sport and Range both roll off at ~46 mph) but the plateau LEVEL scales with the mode's P1 power cap (020B): Sport ~1120 counts/~69 kW, Range ~867 counts/lower, CustomA ~500-700. Below base speed = constant-torque (power rises with rpm). ~60 kW mechanical after losses ~ the S2's ~84 hp rating.

0205.name: per-channel state/health array; byte0 = throttle / twist-grip position
0205.encoding_or_scale: b0 ~= 2.7x throttle% (2.55x s28 / 2.64-2.75x s44), zero-anchored (b0=0 whenever throttle=0)
0205.evidence: s44 moving throttle sweep r=1.000, n=6, 2 zero-anchors; cross-session s28+s44. A DISTINCT field from the RESS 0205 cell array (different module). Raw grip counts are on no CAN frame (nearest broadcast 0x161 throttle%). REVERSE 2026-07-30 (ultracode): b0 is structurally FORWARD-ONLY (zero-anchored, reads 0 in regen/reverse exactly as at closed throttle - the UDS twin of broadcast 0x161 D5) so it cannot encode reverse-throttle magnitude. CAVEAT: b1/b2 IS a genuinely bidirectional channel (s61 dips ~125/62 under drive to ~52/26 under deep regen), never sampled at a true rider reverse-DRIVE extreme - the one place reverse-throttle magnitude might live (needs a UDS-polled reverse-twist capture).

0220.name: pack terminal V (u16@4) + separate nominal/rated ~394 V field (u16@0)
0220.encoding_or_scale: u16@4 ~1 V/count = live terminal V (sags on discharge, rises on charge); u16@0 flat 393-396 = nominal setpoint constant; b8 = 0x01 ride/park / 0x00 charge
0220.evidence: u16@4 pinned across 361 V (s28 sag) -> 402 V (full charge), matches broadcast pack_v +/-1-2 V. SOFTENED: b0:b1 too flat (only +/-3 ct over the 361->403 V swing) to be a live 2nd node - it is the nominal constant, do NOT read 0220 as two live voltages.

0203.name: byte2 = coarse vehicle speed (redundant)
0203.evidence: r=1.000 vs broadcast speed s28/s44/s55; 0 at standstill. Real but a 4th speed copy - low value.

020A.name: active ride-mode ordinal
020A.encoding_or_scale: u8 = mode ordinal 1-9 (Road=1, Sport=2, Rain=3, Range=4, Flat Track=5, Custom A=8, Custom B=9); echoes the BCM 0195/0197 mode-id<->slot map
020A.evidence: s28 mode-cycle: 020A = 1 (Road) / 2 (Sport) / 8 (Custom A), matching the high nibble of the 0x134 active-mode id and the BCM 0194-0197 roster slots (11,01)/(22,02)/(88,08)/(99,09)/(33,03)/(44,04)/(55,05). A clean UDS active-mode indicator (distinct from the config VALUES in 020B).

020B.name: ACTIVE ride-mode calibration triplet: P1=power, P2=regen, P3=throttle-response (per-mode)
020B.encoding_or_scale: 3x LE16, shared hi-byte 0x21 = base; LOW byte of each = a 0-100 per-mode parameter. P1(@0)=power/torque level, P3(@4)=throttle-response/aggressiveness (both CONFIRMED via blip); P2(@2)=regen level (candidate). Changes with the selected ride mode.
020B.evidence: CONFIRMED 2026-07-30 (s63 7-mode cycle WITH return-to-start: Sport read (100,65,75) on all 3 of its segments = zero drift, kills the time-confound). Per-mode low-byte table [P1,P2,P3]: Sport[100,65,75] FlatTrack[100,35,85] Road[85,35,40] Range[45,80,40] Rain[25,20,25] CustomA/B[0,0,0]. IDENTITIES pinned by the throttle-blip discriminator (delivered torque 0x161 @ fixed throttle): Sport-vs-FlatTrack (P1 both 100, P3 75->85) delivered@20% 425->491 => P3=throttle-response; Road-vs-Range (P3 both 40, P1 85->45) delivered@20% 351->294 => P1=power level. P2=regen INFERRED (Range/Eco 80 max, Rain 20 min - not blip-tested). CustomA/B read all-zero (app-programmed config stored elsewhere, not surfaced here). Hard torque/phase clamps are NOT here - mode-INVARIANT VSC 0207 (+1875/-1250, byte-identical across all 7 modes). Corrects the earlier 'static reference triplet' label.

0206.name: security-locked data block
0206.encoding_or_scale: 0x27 security-locked (single gated block; top VSC unlock target)
0206.evidence: the one locked DID on the supervisory controller.

0208.name: NOT pack current (byte0 = binary lateral-activity flag; byte4 = rolling counter)
0208.evidence: REFUTED as current: s28 r=-0.06 over the full -161..+27 A swing, s31 pinned, s35 r=-0.08. The old 'signed system current' promotion rested on narrow-range monotonic co-trends (s13/s16). The genuine UDS pack-current channel is RESS 0209 (a different module). RE-UPHELD 2026-07-30 (s61 mid-ride, widest swing -238..+33 A): held 0x7FFE/0x7FFF (1-LSB toggle) throughout - decisively not current.

RHCM.role: Right Hand Control Module (throttle-side switch pod); part 0812837-0010 / 813636-0066

029A.name: byte2 = GENERAL brake-applied flag (front OR rear)
029A.evidence: r=0.99 s28 (n=11) / 1.00 s44 (n=8) vs broadcast front_brake_press; holds through charge s48. DOWNGRADE 2026-07-29 r1: front-specificity REFUTED - an s57 rear-only brake (0x133 D4=0x10, front=0) set b2, so it flags EITHER brake, not the front lever.

029B.name: dual-track twist-grip raw ADC -> REFUTED as twist-grip (internal reference rail)
029B.encoding_or_scale: chA 06D9=1753 / chB 06DA=1754 of 0FFF=4095, ~43% at rest; small brake-linked sub-field b2:b3 ~558-564
029B.evidence: 6/6 sessions: ADC moved <=~5 counts of 4095 through full throttle sweeps; the SAME analog appears on the throttle-less LHCM and the two modules drift OPPOSITE => internal per-module reference rails, not twist-grip. Single most-corroborated finding. (Raw grip counts sit on VSC 0205 b0 instead.)

029C.name: second live analog -> internal reference rail

RESS.role: Rechargeable Energy Storage System (HV BMS / battery); F193 66000297. Highest-value module - per-cell arrays, live pack current + terminal V.

0205.name: per-cell voltage array (full pack)
0205.encoding_or_scale: 96x BE16 mV/cell = 96S (pinned by direct count); cell-sum/96 = broadcast pack_v
0205.evidence: s25 full untruncated read = 192 B = 96 cells - PINNED by DIRECT COUNT (resolves the old ~100S guess). Direction-responsive: sags under discharge (s28 r=0.97, s31 r=0.963 vs pack_i), rises +42 mV on charge (s32-s35). CAN 0x182 carries only min/max/avg of this array. (The earlier 23-cell read was the mapper's 46-byte truncation.)

0209.name: pack current, dual HV current-sense channels A + B
0209.encoding_or_scale: word0 (u16@0) = channel A wide-range = 1562 + 3.888*I (A) (~0.26 A/count, offset 1562 ct at 0 A); u16@3 (b3:b4) = channel B narrow-range/high-precision, same encoding, HARD-SATURATES at raw ~1432 (~ -33 A)
0209.evidence: word0 r=0.996 over I -240..+35 A (s54/s55/s57), slope 3.888 identical s55/s57; opposite-sign across discharge + charge. Channel B tracks word0 to ~1-4 ct at steady state then CLIPS to a constant while word0 keeps falling (min word0 624 at -241 A) - a range-limited sensor, not a filtered copy (OEM P0B1300 A/B correlation). Clean 6-byte single-frame DID = splice-immune. RETRACTION: the earlier '0209 = pack voltage 400.106 V' was an idle-trap concatenation - it is CURRENT, not V (pack V is 021F/0220). NOTE 2026-07-30: bytes 2 & 5 checked and are noise (|r|<=0.28, best-correlate identity shifts between captures) - NOT the low bytes of a 24-bit current.

020C.name: FF-window over the LOW BYTE of 0209 word0 (pack current)
020C.encoding_or_scale: FF + low byte of 0209 word0 (tracks current incl. sign)
020C.evidence: value-exact on aligned samples: s27 ff1a, s44 ffb6 (= 0209 0x05B6 discharge excursion), s48 ff2a. Corrects the low-hanging audit's '020C -> pack-V mid byte' fold (0209 is current).

021F.name: pack terminal voltage reference
021F.encoding_or_scale: ~1 V/count (distinct from the ~400 V BMS cell-sum)
021F.evidence: matches broadcast pack_v +/-1 V across s25/s26/s28/s29/s31/s32-s35 (discharge + charge), range 365-395 V. THIS (with VSC 0220), not 0209, confirms the 0x181/0x163 pack-V scale against a BMS-internal value.

0213.name: internal fine SoC / SoE (voltage-instantaneous, load-responsive) - NOT SoH, NOT display SoC
0213.encoding_or_scale: BE16 x0.01%; 227A = 8826 => ~88.3%; the 0x227x value is replicated at a fixed offset across >=6 DIDs (0213/021E/0231/0234/0254/021C/0200)
0213.evidence: load-responsive: dips on discharge (s28 r=0.97 vs pack_i, s31 r=0.99), rises on charge 8825->8869 (SoH cannot rise intra-session). Sits ~18-22 pts ABOVE broadcast display-SoC 0x185 (s25 87.2% vs 69%). Roles were previously SWAPPED with 020E - corrected. Exact identity (usable-SoC vs energy) still OPEN - do NOT assert it tracks 0x185.

020E.name: SoH-like reference
020E.evidence: held 0x61=97 UNCHANGED through the entire s57 which ran display-SoC 100->22% - a display-SoC field would have collapsed ~78 pts, so 020E is decoupled from display SoC and behaves like SoH. Pinned ~97% while real display-SoC was ~83%.

020D.name: min/avg/max rollup + wide-range coulomb display-SoC scalar
020D.encoding_or_scale: b0=b1=b2=b5=b8 = repeated coulomb/display-SoC scalar (~1%/count); b4 = mean of the 0206 array; b3/b7 ~= min, b6 ~= max
020D.evidence: the repeated scalar is bit-identical 8/8 sessions (impossible for 9 real sensors); rises 61->95 over the charge and tracks broadcast 0x185 display-SoC DOWN 95->71 on s55 discharge - direction-consistent both ways. RESOLVES the s28 '0213 87% vs display 67%' gap: 020D = wide-range coulomb SoC, 0213 = voltage-instantaneous. CAVEAT 2/8 reads (s27,s44) return an anomalous b4=15 multiplex variant, so the min/avg/max mapping is plausible not airtight.

025A.name: sign-binned lifetime Ah accumulator (charge + discharge buckets)
025A.encoding_or_scale: 20x BE32; dword@32 (idx8) = cumulative CHARGE-Ah (~26.1 mAh/ct candidate); dword@12 (idx3) + dword@72 (idx18) = cumulative DISCHARGE-Ah
025A.evidence: mutually-exclusive freezing across 2 discharge + 3 charge sessions (charge bucket advances only on s32/s39/s48, discharge buckets only on s28/s44) => not a co-trend. Advance CONFIRMED; per-count mAh scale CANDIDATE (needs a large single-swing Ah). MULTI-FRAME ISO-TP: 80-B DID, stays candidate until a clean flow-controlled read locks offsets/scale. REFINED 2026-07-30 (ultracode, s61): discharge bucket set extends to four adjacent dwords {idx3,idx4,idx18,idx19} (idx18/19 ratio 1.19 stable), charge bucket {idx8}; discharge advances idx3/4/18/19 with idx8 frozen, charge advances only idx8.

025B.name: sign-binned lifetime Ah accumulator (2nd unit/copy)
025B.encoding_or_scale: ~59.8 mAh/count candidate; lifetime agrees with 025A to 0.6%
025B.evidence: s32->s48 delivered ~10.8 Ah (025A +419 ct x26.1 = 10.9; 025B +179 ct x59.8 = 10.7 - agree). Multi-frame ISO-TP caveat as 025A.

025E.name: STALE/FROZEN pack snapshot - NOT the live temperature source
025E.encoding_or_scale: 199-byte block; byte-identical across a whole session (does not update with thermal load)
025E.evidence: REFUTED as live per-cell temperature 2026-07-30 (ultracode, s61, spot-checked): 0/199 bytes changed across the entire session (t=0 byte-identical to t=751) through a 42->62 C pack-temperature rise. A stale/reference snapshot; the LIVE per-cell temperature ladder is RESS 0206 (raw-40 C). The earlier x0.1 C reading gave a static ~24.8 C that never tracked heat.

025C.name: SoC-band-binned throughput histogram (2nd accumulator axis)
025C.encoding_or_scale: 120 B = 30x BE32 SoC-band bin counters; 025C/0270 = discharge-side, 0269 = charge-side - THREE DISTINCT histograms, NOT replicas
025C.evidence: dword@84 (idx21, lower-SoC) advances on s28/s31 then freezes; dword@88 (idx22, ~90%) advances in BOTH s44 discharge AND s48 charge, handing off idx21->idx22 as SoC crosses ~88-89%. The coulomb-per-SoC-band data a BMS uses for capacity-fade. REFINED 2026-07-30 (ultracode): 025C/0269/0270 are DISTINCT not replicas - mutually-exclusive regime activation (discharge s61 advances 025C/0270 while 0269 freezes; charge s32/s48 advances 0269 +53/+215 while 025C/0270 freeze). Per-count scale candidate; 120-B ISO-TP-cross-stitch-prone.

0254.name: FF-flagged cell-mV window over the 0205 array
0254.encoding_or_scale: FF + 5-6 cell BE16 mV window; 3887->4177 mV over the charge
0254.evidence: a window of the single 96-cell 0205 array (with 0260 = 7-cell window, 3816->4177 mV), NOT an independent node - reads as cell voltage, direction-responsive. CANDIDATE (multi-frame): dense rides splice it (s55 read garbled) - trust only the park+charge clean reads.

0206.name: live per-cell / per-group battery TEMPERATURE array
0206.encoding_or_scale: 48x u8, T = raw - 40 C (raw 78-109 = 38-69 C); the live per-group pack-temperature ladder (broadcast 0x183 carries only 3 pack thermistors)
0206.evidence: REFINED 2026-07-30 (ultracode, s61 discharge, spot-checked): raw-40 gives 38-69 C = physical battery-temp range, and the array-mean rose 43.2 -> 57.0 C tracking the broadcast pack-temp curve 42 -> 58 C. Mid-session DIP (mean 57.7 -> 55.6 C at coast) rules out a monotonic counter/accumulator; magnitude+trend match rules out the old 'DoD/throughput index' and 'balance/IR' readings. Small +1-2 move on charge = little heating on charge, consistent. Distinct from 025E (a FROZEN snapshot, not the live source). 0210 embeds this array + a separate fast block; 021C is a distinct (hi,lo)-pair array - neither is this temperature.

0204.name: live oscillating BMS estimate (NOT a monotonic counter)
0204.encoding_or_scale: twin mirrored BE32 (w0==w1 always) + trailing byte ~45-47; w0 oscillates ~953-998 both directions
0204.evidence: CONTRADICTS the earlier 'counts down' reading 2026-07-30 (ultracode, s61, 11 polls, spot-checked): w0 = 989/985/957/998/998/971/978/985/953/972/972 - rises AND falls repeatedly, not monotonic. A load-dependent live estimate (candidate: instantaneous power / time- or range-to-empty), sourced from 0200's head; units open. The old '-1 per session' was a 2-snapshot artifact.

025F.name: per-cell passive-balancing overlay -> RETRACTED (ISO-TP artifact)
025F.evidence: the high byte 'flips 00->4C/4D on charge' was an ISO-TP reassembly SPLICE, not a balance bitmap: 0x4C/0x4D are exactly the low bytes of cell voltages 0x104C/0x104D (4172-4173 mV) that only occur at high charge - a cell-array frame cross-stitched into the adjacent accumulator DID by the round-robin poll (all RESS DIDs share responder 0x7EE). Same for 0260/0262. No genuine balance bitmap was isolatable; owed an imbalanced/aged-cell capture or a chunked flow-controlled read.

EHCU.role: Electro-Hydraulic Control Unit (Bosch ABS); F1EE 40800178 == dash "EHCU 0 ID#40800178"; full Bosch BOM + VIN un-gated at F1EF

020F.name: live dual per-wheel ABS speed
020F.encoding_or_scale: u16@0 = FRONT, u16@2 = REAR, big-endian; ~25x the broadcast 0x326 count (~250 counts/km/h); 0/0 at standstill
020F.evidence: STRONGEST attribution in the corpus - s10-s16 r=1.0 in 6/6 + s28/s31 streamed (real-ts, r=1.000). Rear (driven) wheel LEADS front by discrete +256-ct quanta (~2-4% = mild TC-active slip) and never trails; no burnout captured. REVERSE 2026-07-30 (ultracode): both channels are UNSIGNED magnitude, blind to direction - in reverse they only rise in positive magnitude as rpm deepens, never wrap above 0x8000; cannot detect reverse or sub-threshold creep.

0212.name: live front-brake-pressure block
0212.encoding_or_scale: u16@4 front-brake pressure; broadcast ~= 1.214*0212 + 14 (0212 ~= 0.79x broadcast); byte5/6 low nibble 0/2/4/6 = candidate parked brake-lever position
0212.evidence: zero at rest, spikes every front-brake event; s28 r=1.0 / s31 r=0.999 (0->415) / s44 r=0.999 (0->2241). Scale refined s44: NOT 1:1, a 0.79 proportional factor (0212's slow poll capped at 1461, missing the 2241 peak). Neither is absolute pressure (no bar/psi ref).

0210.name: brake-application block (coarser 2nd channel); byte1 = brake-active flag
0210.evidence: s10 r0.92 / s14 r1.0; byte1 flips on press (s29); 0 on zero-brake rides (s11/s13).

0200.name: wheel-speed head (b0-1 coarse speed) + 12 V aux-rail scalar (b3)
0200.encoding_or_scale: b0/b1 = coarse vehicle speed (0 at park/charge, scales with ride speed); b3 ~= 174-178 = ~14 V aux rail
0200.evidence: two fields in one DID (6 sessions). b0 = 28 s28 / 9 s44 / 92 s55 scaling with speed; 0 at park + every charge session. A 5th speed copy - redundant but direction-consistent.

0211.name: 12 V aux rail (~14.1 V) - NOT a wake counter
0211.evidence: s14 decisive - value wobbles 176<->178 BOTH directions; a counter only increments. Resolves the map's open 'rail OR counter'.

021D.name: resettable use-counter / index - NOT a temperature
021D.encoding_or_scale: u16 (2-byte, same format on active sweep AND streamed poll - no truncation); increments slowly with use, resets to a low value on module power loss
021D.evidence: REFUTED as temperature 2026-07-30 (ultracode, spot-checked): dead-FLAT within every session (s61 = 10 for all 11 polls, s59 = 7) while broadcast 0x183 temp1 rose 39->71 C (s57) / 39->58 C (s61) - a live sensor cannot stay flat through a 30 C rise. The catalog's cross-session 243->250 'tracking' + 'returns to baseline' was actually a monotonic counter that RESET on a power cycle (243/243/243/244/246/250 then reset -> 7 -> 10). Resolves the apparent payload-length puzzle (both paths return the same 2-byte u16). A per-session use/op counter; exact unit open.

021B.name: ABS operating / event counters
021B.encoding_or_scale: little-endian LE32 framed by 0x3207 record markers: 67811, paired 10132/10183, 5009, 408
021B.evidence: ABS/EBD intervention + operating stats, nowhere on CAN; block REORGANIZES idle->charge (a live rolling log). LE trailing zeros confirm endianness. UPDATE 2026-07-30 (ultracode): 021B DOES respond on the streamed path - a complete 400-B multi-frame reassembles on s28/s32/s55/s57 (leading marker 07 32.., byte2 advances 18->19 s55->s57); absent only on s26/s61 (intermittent). 0232.name: charger / plug-state word
0232.encoding_or_scale: 00 00 02 00 = NOT taking charge; 02 01 02 02 = charging (entire duration); mirrored at 0200 bytes 8-11
0232.evidence: 100% separation over 12 sessions (parked/riding/mid-charge-unplugged s44 all show not-charging; s32/s39/s48 charging). Single ISO-TP frame (zero reassembly risk). The s44 A/B (unplugged mid-charge -> 00000200) rules out a session-type artifact. A clean plugged/charging boolean over UDS.

0209.name: charge-current / charge-power indicator
0209.encoding_or_scale: FF + byte1; byte1 = 0x00 not-charging / 0x4F(79) at CC (~11 A) / 0x24(36) at CV taper (~4 A)
0209.evidence: steps with charge stage, zero when not charging (s44 unplugged A/B = 0). FE10/FEE1 share the same body with a trailing 16-bit magnitude word (0xB710 @~11 A -> 0x6B62 @~4 A). Absolute A-scale open. (Distinct DID from RESS 0209 - different module.)

0201.evidence: a thermal ARC that COOLS when charge current drops - a voltage/SoC would stay high at full charge, so this is temperature. Promotes the 0200 ~700 internal 4-ch sensor cluster (031B/02B8/02BF = 795/696/703). Exact C scale/offset still open (raw needs a cold-soak read; suspect a -40 platform offset).

0235.name: pre-contactor DC-link voltage (bytes3-4) + coarse pack terminal-voltage byte (byte5)
0235.encoding_or_scale: bytes3-4 x0.1 V rose 405->411 V on charge (~+8 V above RESS terminal = a distinct DC-link node); byte5 ~2.55 V/count, b5 ~= 0.39*pack_v
0235.evidence: byte5 DOWNGRADE 2026-07-29 r1 (adversarial QA): it was briefly promoted as a coarse CURRENT mirror - a LOAD-SAG-TRAP artifact, RETRACTED. Pooled n=62 (s28+s44+s54+s55+s57): r(b5,pack_v)=+0.999 vs r(b5,pack_i)=+0.850, and the voltage-model slope is session-stable (0.34-0.45 ct/V) while the current-model slope wanders 3x. So byte5 = coarse terminal-VOLTAGE, not current. CAVEAT 2026-07-30 (s61 mid-ride discharge): the bytes3-4 DC-link word did NOT sag with the pack under -238 A load (stayed ~400 V while broadcast pack_v fell to ~300 V) - so the '+8 V distinct DC-link node' behaviour only proved out on the CHARGE side; under drive it reads nominal/rated, not the live terminal (use RESS 021F / VSC 0220 for live V).

0200.name: pack / DC-link NOMINAL voltage (x0.1 V, ~400 rated) + internal 4-ch sensor cluster + mirrored plug-state
0200.encoding_or_scale: 0F A0 word = 4000 -> x0.1 = 400.0 V idle, rising to 404.3 V on charge; bytes 8-11 mirror 0232 plug-state; ~700 sensor triplet = charger temps
0200.evidence: corrects the earlier x0.0625=250.0 V setpoint guess - the scale is x0.1 V. byte0=0xFF alias structure (0210 = FF A0.. vs 0200 = 0F A0..). CAVEAT 2026-07-30 (s61 mid-ride): this is a NOMINAL/rated node, NOT the live sagging terminal - it stayed pinned {3999,4000} while broadcast pack_v sagged to ~300 V under -238 A (r=-0.216 vs pack_v). Use RESS 021F / VSC 0220 for live terminal V.

FEE0.name: charge-state-multiplexed value - NOT a monotonic lifetime counter
FEE0.encoding_or_scale: ~4333 not-charging / ~1520 charging; non-monotonic WITHIN a charge session
FEE0.evidence: RETRACTED as a lifetime op counter: reads ~4333 parked/riding (incl. s44 unplugged) and ~1520 while charging, and is non-monotonic within a charge (s32 1523->1510 falling, s48 1513->1524 rising) - a lifetime counter cannot decrease or jump by mode. Reconciles the doc's own 'decrements to 1523' (charge state) vs 'increments 4335->4337' (idle state). Meaning open (a mode-dependent time/energy-to-full estimate is the leading hypothesis).

FEE1.name: shares FE10's charge-current-register body - NOT a paired accumulator

FEE1.evidence: REFUTED as a monotone accumulator: FE10/FEE1 are a LIVE charge-current register (see 0209), not a counter - the magnitude word steps with charge stage (0xB710 @~11 A -> 0x6B62 @~4 A) and is zero when not charging. The prior 'FE10/FEE1 = coulomb accumulator' reading is dead.

service_support._note: Live NRC-gating probe over the LAN 2026-07-29 (Diagnostics/TX, extended session via 0x10 03). Bare-SID / seed requests ONLY - non-actuating (no valid identifier => nothing actuated; every request was rejected). Legend: 0x13 incorrectLength => service SUPPORTED (parsed the SID); 0x11 serviceNotSupported; 0x33 securityAccessDenied => supported but LOCKED; 0x22 conditionsNotCorrect; seed128 => 0x27 level-1 returned a 16-byte (128-bit) random seed. CAVEAT: 0x13 on a bare service means the ECU validated FORMAT before any security check, so a well-formed request may still NRC 0x33 - NOT yet proven ungated.
highlights: BCM (owns lights/signals) SUPPORTS 0x2F IO-control AND 0x31 routine, returning 0x13 (not 0x33) on a bare probe => output control is REACHABLE; any security gate is post-format. Untested whether a well-formed 2F actuates or NRCs 0x33.
Writes (0x2E) are security-locked (0x33) on VSC/RESS/OBC; routines (0x31) locked on RHCM/LHCM; OBC locks BOTH write + IO-control.
VSC (inverter supervisory) exposes NO IO-control (0x11) and locks writes => no UDS actuation of inverter outputs without the 0x27 key.
TCU supports 0x2E/0x2F/0x31 all UNLOCKED on the bare probe (0x13) - the most open control surface, but 'send SMS' is not a UDS primitive and the M2M SIM is likely data-only.
Every module returns a 128-bit seed at 0x27 level 1 (requesting is harmless). EHCU 0x27 => 0x22 conditionsNotCorrect (needs a specific state/session).
Unmapped responders 0x6DE and 0x7F2 were SILENT to physical-addressed 0x22/0x3E (may need functional addressing or a specific state).

IO-CONTROL ENUMERATION 2026-07-29 (on-device /uds/sweep?io=1, non-actuating 2F<DID>00): ZERO IO-control DIDs on BCM (0x0000-0x0FFF) and RESS/EHCU/TCU/LHCM (0x0000-0x03FF) - every 2F<DID>00 => NRC 0x31 (requestOutOfRange). So 0x2F is a stack stub with no populated DIDs in the searchable low range; actuator/output tests are almost certainly RoutineControl (0x31), whose RIDs are undocumented (64k space) and unsafe to brute-force on the BCM (fob-table-wipe risk). Actuation (blink lights, ABS test, ...) is DT-II-recipe-gated, same wall as fob-pairing. Do NOT re-hunt the 0x2F low range.
